hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[^[:alnum:]])git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]].*--force'; then branch=$(git -C '/Users/guilherme/Documents/IA/ANEST V2' rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"BLOQUEADO: git push --force (ou --force-with-lease) em main. Crie uma branch ou refaça o commit local."}}'; fi; fi

input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])firebase[[:space:]]+deploy([[:space:]]|$)'; then cd '/Users/guilherme/Documents/IA/ANEST V2' && local_h=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null) && remote_h=$(git rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$local_h" ] && [ -n "$remote_h" ] && [ "$local_h" != "$remote_h" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage":"⚠️  HEAD local difere de origin/main. Faça git push antes do deploy (regra obrigatória do CLAUDE.md)."}'; fi; fi

input=$(cat); should_log=$(echo "$input" | jq -r 'if .tool_response.success == false then "yes" else "no" end'); if [ "$should_log" = "yes" ]; then mkdir -p '/Users/guilherme/Documents/IA/ANEST V2/.claude/logs' && echo "$input" | jq -c '{ts: now, tool: .tool_name, input: .tool_input, error: .tool_response}' >> '/Users/guilherme/Documents/IA/ANEST V2/.claude/logs/tool-failures.jsonl'; fi

cd '/Users/guilherme/Documents/IA/ANEST V2' 2>/dev/null && b=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null) && c=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && [ -n "$b" ] && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"📍 Branch: %s | %s arquivo(s) não commitado(s)"}}' "$b" "$c"
